# `villager_customers.keeper` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

### `class KeeperHooks` — `src/main/java/villager_customers/keeper/KeeperHooks.java`
The claim-taking seek KeeperSeekBehavior runs, and the read-only state snapshot villager_customers.debug.DebugCommand's keeper subcommand reports (`docs/spec/domains/keeper.md` `KEEPER-REQ-004`..`007`).
- `boolean isAdultNitwit(Villager villager)` — An adult (not baby) villager whose profession is NITWIT (`KEEPER-REQ-003`, `014`).
- `Optional<GlobalPos> seekAndClaim(ServerLevel level, Villager villager)` — Finds the nearest eligible seat (`KEEPER-REQ-005`, `006`) and claims it (`KEEPER-REQ-007`) in one step, trying the next-nearest candidate if a claim attempt loses a same-tick race.
- `KeeperState state(ServerLevel level, Villager villager)` — The keeper state villager_customers.debug.DebugCommand's keeper subcommand reports: whether it is even a candidate at all, whether it is currently seated, its claimed seat if any, and its cooldown value if any.
- `void clearClaimsForTesting()` — Test-only: clears every seat claim, so one game test never sees another's leftovers.

    - **nested** `record KeeperState(boolean adultNitwit, boolean seated, Optional<GlobalPos> claimedSeat, Optional<Long> cooldownGameTime)`
    A snapshot of one villager's keeper state, for villager_customers.debug.DebugCommand's keeper subcommand.

### `class KeeperMemoryModules` — `src/main/java/villager_customers/keeper/KeeperMemoryModules.java`
The two memory modules a nitwit's keeper seek lives in (`docs/spec/04-architecture.md` `ARCH-DEC-006`; `docs/spec/domains/keeper.md` §5's own Approach), mirroring villager_customers.customer.CustomerMemoryModules's trip-target/cooldown shape.
- `MemoryModuleType<GlobalPos> KEEPER_CLAIMED_SEAT` — villager_customers:keeper_claimed_seat — the seat being walked to, or already kept (`KEEPER-REQ-007`..`012`).
- `MemoryModuleType<Long> KEEPER_SEEK_COOLDOWN` — villager_customers:keeper_seek_cooldown — the game time of the next allowed seek (`KEEPER-REQ-004`, `KEEPER-DEC-003`).
- `void register()` — Registers both memory modules.

### `class KeeperRegistration` — `src/main/java/villager_customers/keeper/KeeperRegistration.java`
This package's single entry point into VillagerCustomers.onInitialize (`docs/spec/04-architecture.md` `ARCH-DEC-006`), mirroring villager_customers.customer.CustomerRegistration.
- `void register()` — Registers the keeper-seek memory modules.

### `class KeeperSeatSearch` — `src/main/java/villager_customers/keeper/KeeperSeatSearch.java`
Searches for eligible Create seats near a stock ticker, nearest to the search origin first (`docs/spec/domains/keeper.md` §3 "Seat eligibility", `KEEPER-REQ-005`..`007`; mirrors villager_customers.shop.ShopSearch's own "nearest first" convention, `SHOP-DEC-001`).
- `List<GlobalPos> near(ServerLevel level, BlockPos origin, int radius, long gameTime)` — Every eligible, unclaimed seat within radius of origin (`KEEPER-REQ-005`, `006`), nearest to origin first (`KEEPER-REQ-007`).
- `boolean isEligibleSeat(ServerLevel level, BlockPos seatPos)` — A live recheck of one seat's own eligibility (block, occupancy, and its ticker's keeper presence), the same "recomputed fresh every call, nothing cached" convention villager_customers.shop.Shop#at already uses (`SHOP-DEC-002`-style).

### `class KeeperSeekBehavior` — `src/main/java/villager_customers/keeper/KeeperSeekBehavior.java`
The seek-and-seat state machine run in Activity.IDLE (`docs/spec/04-architecture.md` `ARCH-DEC-006`; `docs/spec/domains/keeper.md` `KEEPER-REQ-003`..`013`), added through the same mixin as villager_customers.customer.ShoppingTripBehavior (villager_customers.mixin.VillagerBrainMixin), gated internally to an adult NITWIT rather than by which villagers the behaviour is added to — mirroring how ShoppingTripBehavior is added unconditionally and gates itself on Activity.WORK.
- `KeeperSeekBehavior()`
- `boolean checkExtraStartConditions(ServerLevel level, Villager villager)`
- `void start(ServerLevel level, Villager villager, long gameTime)`
- `boolean canStillUse(ServerLevel level, Villager villager, long gameTime)`
- `void tick(ServerLevel level, Villager villager, long gameTime)`
- `void stop(ServerLevel level, Villager villager, long gameTime)`
- `boolean isRidingSeatAt(Villager villager, GlobalPos target)` — Whether villager is currently riding the SeatEntity at target's position — the one signal both this class and KeeperHooks#state use to tell "seated" apart from "still walking" or "unseated" (`KEEPER-REQ-009`..`012`).

### `class SeatClaims` — `src/main/java/villager_customers/keeper/SeatClaims.java`
The non-persistent per-server claim a seeking nitwit holds on a seat, so two concurrent seeks never both walk to the same one (`docs/spec/domains/keeper.md` `KEEPER-REQ-007`; this ticket's own Approach, choosing between a vanilla PoiManager reservation and a claim structure of this mod's own).
- `boolean isClaimed(GlobalPos seat, long gameTime)` — Whether seat is currently claimed by anyone (expired claims are pruned first).
- `boolean tryClaim(GlobalPos seat, UUID villagerId, long gameTime, long expiresAtGameTime)` — Attempts to claim seat for villagerId, expiring at expiresAtGameTime.
- `void release(GlobalPos seat, UUID villagerId)` — Releases seat's claim if it is still held by villagerId (a no-op otherwise).
- `void clearForTesting()` — Test-only: clears every claim, so one game test never sees another's leftovers.
